description: This Java class defines the 'RetrieveResourcesStrategy', a final class that extends 'AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy' specific to handling 'RetrieveResources' commands within a policy persistence framework. It contains methods to execute the retrieval process for policy resources, returning results or errors based on policy entries, and computes entities tags for versioning.

classes.name: RetrieveResourcesStrategy
classes.description: This final class implements a strategy for handling 'RetrieveResources' commands by fetching policy entries and returning their associated resources, along with handling entity tags for versioning.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the main logic to retrieve resources for a given policy based on the command and contextual information, returning either a successful result with resources or an error if the policy entry is not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes and returns the next entity tag representing the resources associated with the specified policy and command, aiding in version control.
